name: Bob haircuts and short hairstyle transformations
what_it_is: A cluster of salon and selfie-style clips showing bob haircuts — chin-length bobs, blunt cuts, two-tone bobs and pixie/short cuts — including cutting and blow-dry styling, plus a couple of clips that only mention the bob style or use bob-themed audio. Most videos center on the bob look itself or a salon cut reveal rather than a single shared event.
